verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an open-source engine's documentation site could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Probes found that bevy.org/llms.txt returns 404, the markdown docs variant returns 404, and docs.rs serves no llms.txt either. Standard crawlable API reference docs on docs.rs are ordinary human-oriented documentation, an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story.
